commits.message:
Add explicit not found response for missing cache keys

Introduces a RES_NOT_FOUND response code for cache read and readAndDelete operations when a key is missing, instead of returning a generic error. Updates server and client logic to handle this new response, modifies TypeScript types to reflect that these methods return null for missing keys, and adjusts tests to expect null or the new response code for non-existent keys.

Add TypeScript type definitions and update package.json

Introduced index.d.ts with type definitions for NetCacheServer and NetCacheClient, including their options and methods. Updated package.json to reference the new types file.

Add GitHub Actions workflow for package release

Introduces a workflow to build, set version, and create a release for the package using GitHub Actions. The workflow supports manual version input, validates version format, updates package.json, and creates a GitHub release.

Add NetCacheClient implementation and tests

Introduces the NetCacheClient class for interacting with the NetCacheServer, supporting connect, disconnect, write, read, and readAndDelete operations. Adds comprehensive tests for NetCacheClient covering successful operations, error handling, concurrent requests, and disconnect behavior.

Implement TCP-based in-memory cache server with tests

Added NetCacheServer class implementing a simple TCP protocol for in-memory key-value caching with write, read, and read-and-delete operations. Introduced a protocol definition in common.cjs, comprehensive tests in index.test.cjs, and updated the test script in package.json. The server supports configurable entry lifetimes and handles protocol errors robustly.

Initialize project with ESLint and basic setup

Add initial project files including .gitignore, ESLint configuration, and package files. Set up a basic entry point in index.cjs and configure ESLint for Node.js development.

Use scratch final stage; explicit EXPOSE

Add a minimal final stage (FROM scratch) and COPY the filesystem from the base image to produce a smaller, minimal runtime image. Update EXPOSE entries to use explicit TCP protocol (3000/tcp, 15000/tcp). Keeps SSL_CERT_FILE env and existing CMD.

Add CI workflow, Dockerfile, and config

Introduce a GitHub Actions workflow to build and push container images to GitHub Container Registry (workflow_dispatch with release and agentgateway inputs, metadata tagging, docker build-push, and release note creation). Add a multi-stage Dockerfile based on openSUSE Tumbleweed that downloads the Agent Gateway binary (via AGENTGATEWAY_VERSION ARG), strips unnecessary packages to produce a minimal image, copies CA bundle and config, exposes ports 3000 and 15000, and sets the default command. Add a basic config.yaml with logging, admin address, and an HTTP listener for /mcp.
